items.title: 45% of US Independent Arts Publications Face Existential Crisis, Report Finds

items.title: The Secret Life of Hockney's Beverly Hills Housewife
items.summary: Taking David Hockney’s painting of arts patron Betty Freeman as his subject, James Cahill tells the engrossing story of two friends who shaped the cultural landscape of 1960s Los Angeles.
